checks.name: nested_file
checks.code:
from archive import extract_archive
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile,zipfile
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
 p=Path(d); z=p/'a.zip'
 with zipfile.ZipFile(z,'w') as f: f.writestr('docs/a.txt','ok')
 assert extract_archive(z,p/'out')==['docs/a.txt'] and (p/'out/docs/a.txt').read_text()=='ok'

checks.name: traversal_preflight
checks.code:
from archive import extract_archive
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile,zipfile
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
 p=Path(d); z=p/'a.zip'
 with zipfile.ZipFile(z,'w') as f:
  f.writestr('good.txt','ok'); f.writestr('../escape.txt','bad')
 try: extract_archive(z,p/'out')
 except ValueError: pass
 else: raise AssertionError('traversal accepted')
 assert not (p/'out/good.txt').exists() and not (p/'escape.txt').exists()
